description: Find recent public procurement notices of the EU's official TED portal (Tenders Electronic Daily: 27 EU countries + EEA) by keywords, buyer country and type (open tenders, planned procurements or contract awards). Returns up to 10 newest notices with title, buyer, country, deadline, estimated value and link. For more notices, UK Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, SAM.gov and Grants.gov, buyer contacts, CPV/NAICS filters or daily alerts it points to the full Public Tenders & Procurement Scraper Actor on Apify.

countries.description: Optional buyer countries as ISO codes, comma-separated, e.g. "ES, FR, DE"

days.description: Published in the last N days, 1-30 (default 7)

keywords.description: Words to find in the notice, comma-separated for OR, e.g. "software, cloud hosting"

type.description: tender = open calls (default), planned = prior information, award = contract awards

name: search_public_tenders
title: Search EU public tenders on TED (lite, up to 10 notices)
